title: Hyderabad principal stabbed 27 times: How last ‘babu’ call exposed Class 10 killers
content: Two Class 10 students were apprehended for the murder of principal Roopa Reddy. Police allege the students killed her after she caught one stealing from her home. Investigators noticed the students spending money lavishly after the murder occurred. Forensic examination detected blood traces on cash recovered from one student. The juveniles have been produced before the Juvenile Justice Board for further proceedings.

title: Manav Suthar scripts history, equals 93-year-old Indian Test record
content: In a stunning debut, Manav Suthar has made history as the first spinner to secure five wickets in both his first home and away Tests, a remarkable achievement not seen since Mohammad Nisar in 1933. At just a young age, he also became the youngest Indian to claim ten wickets in a single Test match, eclipsing Harbhajan Singh's previous record.

title: Delhi removes Pak high commission's barricades after similar gesture by Islamabad
content: Indian authorities removed the external security cordon around the Pakistan High Commission. Traffic bollards and barricades were dismantled from the diplomatic compound premises. This action effectively eliminated the external security perimeter outside the high commission. The Pakistan High Commission is situated within the Chanakyapuri diplomatic enclave.

title: CEO Sundar Pichai has a quiz for students about Google Search
content: Google CEO Sundar Pichai unveiled new educational features tailored for students. These enhancements are designed to facilitate topic comprehension and exam preparation. Gemini now includes a specialized student hub, complete with study notebooks and various learning tools. Furthermore, eligible college students can access free subscriptions to Google AI Pro or Plus, alongside bundled discounts for AI Pro and YouTube Premium.

title: Woman in soup for ‘We are Gen Z’ remark
content: A tourist's 'Gen Z' declaration at a Ladakh checkpoint drew criticism from the Chief Minister.  She argued with security personnel after a five-hour delay due to VIP movement.  The incident occurred before Kargil Vijay Diwas commemorative events in the region.  Former army officers also condemned her behavior towards uniformed personnel.  The event sparked debate on tourist conduct at sensitive border checkpoints.

title: Karnataka: Father 'pushes' 2 children into canal for favouring mother, both die
content: Two children's bodies were recovered from an irrigation canal after their father allegedly pushed them. The nine-year-old girl and her two-and-a-half-year-old brother were found during a search operation. Police received an emergency call from the father, Shantappa, who was with his six-year-old daughter. He reportedly stated the deceased children were closer to their mother and did not get along with him.

title: Meet 10-yr-old Hsu Ting-wei, winner of Silicon Valley invention award
content: At the Silicon Valley International Festival, Taiwanese innovators caught the global spotlight with remarkable inventions. A ten-year-old prodigy took home a prestigious award for crafting an AI-driven electronic nose capable of detecting hazardous substances and potentially stopping disease outbreaks. This year, Taiwanese competitors celebrated a landmark achievement, claiming twenty-four gold medals and numerous honors, showcasing their ingenuity and practical solutions that captivated both judges and audiences.

title: Pulitzer-winning poet transformed barren Hawaii land into 19-acre forest
content: W.S. Merwin, a celebrated poet, found solace and seclusion in Maui during the 1970s, where he dedicated himself to creating a lush 19-acre palm forest. This extraordinary project transformed a barren piece of land into a thriving ecological haven, showcasing an impressive array of palm species. Today, the Merwin Conservancy diligently safeguards this rich environmental legacy, ensuring it remains a vital part of our natural heritage.

title: US issues details of new Green Card rules coming into effect from September 18
content: New Green Card rules take effect September 18, 2026, impacting all applications. USCIS will conduct a stricter public charge test on applicants' circumstances. Receipt of public benefits after this date will count against applicants significantly. A broader range of benefits will now be considered by USCIS officers. The updated guidance applies to all adjustment of status applications submitted then.

title: Statues vandalised, vehicles torched after students rally turns violent in Meghalaya
content: During a turbulent Khasi Students' Union bike rally in Shillong, statues were defaced and government vehicles set ablaze, highlighting the escalating agitation over a five-point charter of demands. Their protest also aimed at opposing a public hearing for a proposed limestone mining project. This rally was marked by an ultimatum issued by the union prior to the symbolic black-flag demonstration, reflecting their deep-seated grievances.

title: King Charles 'welcomes' Harry, Meghan’s UK 'return'
content: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are set to visit Britain later this month, bringing along their children, Archie and Lilibet, who will soon attend a British school. King Charles is eager for the chance to reconnect with his grandchildren in a private setting. Since taking a step back from royal responsibilities in March 2020, the dynamics between the couple and the royal family remain intricate and challenging.

title: Delhi’s invisible opponent: How drift is becoming a factor at the Worlds
content: Indoor air currents are presenting a significant tactical challenge for players at the BWF World Championships.  Shuttlers must constantly recalibrate their strokes and shot selection due to unpredictable air movement.  Different courts and even ends of the same court demand distinct adjustments from competitors.  This atmospheric variable has influenced match outcomes and player performance throughout the tournament.  Mastering these unseen air currents is proving as crucial as traditional badminton skills.

title: India recreate Ganguly's shirt-waving celebration after beating England at Lord's
content: After India defeated England by 118 runs in a T20 match at Lord's on August 19, India's players took off their shirts and waved them in the air, recalling Ganguly's famous celebration after India's NatWest Trophy final win over England at the same venue in 2002.

title: 'Awarapan 2' box office day 6: Emraan Hashmi starrer sees inches towards Rs 110 cr
content: Awarapan 2 is proving to be a box office hit, amassing an impressive Rs 107.50 crore net across India by its sixth day. The film's take surged on Saturday, thanks to the holiday and extra screenings, though earnings saw a modest decline on Wednesday. The sequel capitalizes on the first film's lingering popularity and its emotionally resonant storyline.

title: 6.8 CGPA student lands Rs 32 lakh Microsoft job: What his journey says
content: The debate over whether marks determine success has resurfaced after a post highlighted the contrasting journeys of two engineering graduates. Aditya Jamwal, reportedly a 6.8 CGPA student, is now a software engineer at Microsoft. His story underscores how practical skills, projects, problem-solving ability and industry-ready knowledge can sometimes matter more than academic scores.

title: Granite, grass and a helipad: Trump shows off his White House construction projects
content: During a recent briefing, President Trump showcased key updates on White House renovations. He emphasized the stunning white granite driveway's completion and tackled technical aspects of the helipad's slope. Proudly, he mentioned enhancements to the exterior and landscaping. Additionally, he touched upon the ongoing ballroom construction and its significance for national security, aiming to reassure the public about progress in the iconic residence.

title: 'I fed her salt': Prime accused denies killing 18-yr-old woman in Jorhat, claims he tried to save her
content: Aryan Goswami, the prime accused, denied killing Anwesha Saikia and claimed he tried to save her. He stated she consumed drugs at a party and later blacked out in front of him. His friends, Monalisa Nath and Arpita Kakoty, also denied involvement in her death. Anwesha's family rejected their account and alleged murder, pointing to injury marks. CCTV footage showed Goswami and friends dragging Saikia to the parking area.

title: Taiwan gets new F-16 amid China threat: Why 50-yr-old jet remains popular
content: Taiwan is on the brink of a significant upgrade as it prepares to take delivery of its first batch of new F-16 fighter jets from the United States. This addition of 66 advanced F-16V Block 70 models is a strategic move to enhance Taiwan's aerial defense amid escalating military tensions with China. With its cutting-edge technology and ongoing upgrades, the F-16 remains a crucial asset for Taiwan's defense forces.

title: Gave up IIT, slept on roads: How Rajasthan's 1st AGM put Udaipur on global chess map
content: Udaipur’s Chandrajeet Singh Rajawat turned a difficult childhood passion for chess into a successful career. He left home as a teenager, faced financial struggles, slept at railway stations and stadiums, and kept playing despite setbacks. His persistence eventually brought recognition, coaching opportunities and his own academy, Kingdom of Chess, which now operates across around 30 countries.

title: Kolkata hotel fire: Leaseholder of Hotel Shikha Inn Abu Zafar arrested
content: Kolkata Police arrested Abu Zafar, the leaseholder of Hotel Shikha Inn.  He was apprehended from Entally Main Market on Wednesday.  Two hotel staff members were also detained for questioning regarding the incident.  Investigators are examining the circumstances and safety protocols at the hotel.  Further details concerning the fire investigation are currently awaited.

title: AIIMS Rishikesh held for wrong HIV positive diagnosis, told to pay Rs 60K compensation
content: AIIMS Rishikesh was found guilty of medical negligence by a consumer commission.  The hospital incorrectly recorded a patient as HIV positive in its medical records.  Subsequent tests at other hospitals found the patient to be HIV negative.  The commission upheld a compensation of fifty thousand rupees and ten thousand rupees for costs.  AIIMS Rishikesh failed to provide an adequate explanation for the erroneous diagnosis.

title: Rs 20 lakh Chinese stock dispute, violent outburst: Twisha Sharma’s final hours
content: The conflict surrounding a twenty lakh rupee investment escalated dramatically as Samarth Singh was said to have pressured Twisha Sharma into moving funds for Chinese stock purchases. Twisha's family leveled accusations against Samarth and his mother, citing cruelty and harassment. Shocking evidence from CCTV captured Twisha's solitary visit to the terrace, and medical assessments concluded that her death resulted from suicide.

title: Five minutes, 28 covers, 300 tyres: How Galle's 130-member groundstaff beat the rain
content: The rain may have tested Galle, but its groundstaff never blinked. Meet the 130-member groundstaff, who raced against the weather, mastered the art of covering the ground and ensured precious playing time was not lost during the first Test between India vs Sri Test played at the Galle International Cricket Stadium.

title: Who signed where? NFL players who joined new teams ahead of the 2026 season
content: In an electrifying 2026 offseason, several NFL stars have altered their team trajectories from square one. Quarterbacks Tua Tagovailoa and Justin Fields are the latest to don new uniforms. Among wide receivers, both A.J. Brown and Stefon Diggs have switched allegiances. Defensive legend Myles Garrett now aims for glory with different squad, reflecting a broader trend of running backs, and defensive backs securing new homes across the league.

title: Oil price today: Crude remains above $90 as Hormuz operations remain disrupted
content: Oil prices have settled at elevated levels, staying above ninety dollars per barrel. Investors are weighing the unpredictable US-Iran situation and the potential impacts on shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz. While intermittent Middle East assaults bolster market sentiment, the absence of further escalations keeps a lid on price surges. Additionally, the UAE's suspension of financial transactions with Iran has raised regional tensions.

title: Patrick Mahomes’ wife Brittany opens up about year-long wrist struggle
content: Brittany Mahomes recently opened up about her diagnosis of De Quervain's tenosynovitis, stemming from persistent wrist pain over the past year. In a candid Instagram post, she shared a glimpse of her wrist brace and reflected on her journey, especially after recovering from a fractured back post-childbirth. Despite this setback, Mahomes remains committed to her fitness regime, emphasizing the importance of listening to one's body and prioritizing health.

title: DEA to investigate Hayden Panettiere’s sudden passing
content: The unexpected death of Hayden Panettiere on August 16 has prompted a thorough investigation, now involving the Drug Enforcement Administration. While the coroner's office has yet to establish an official cause of death, there were mentions of overdose and cardiac arrest during the emergency call. Known for her candid discussions about addiction and mental health, Panettiere's passing raises significant concerns.

title: US military newspaper publisher quits amid Pentagon row over editorial freedom
content: Max Lederer Jr., the publisher of Stars and Stripes, has stepped down amidst disputes over editorial independence. The Pentagon's push for more oversight has sparked tension regarding the military newspaper's objective reporting. Their recent pieces on poor conditions and declining morale reportedly led to criticism from the Department of Defense, prompting the ousting of the ombudsman who protected editorial freedom.

title: NBA trade news: Cleveland Cavaliers secure $88 million star in 5-team trade
content: Peyton Watson, 23, leaves the Denver Nuggets for the Cleveland Cavaliers in a mid-August sign-and-trade also touching the Clippers, Wizards and Kings. Cleveland sends out Max Strus and Tre Mann while adding Watson and forward Cam Whitmore. Watson signs a four-year, $88 million contract with a player option and trade kicker, joining Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Evan Mobley and Jarrett Allen in Cleveland's projected starting five.

title: NCERT recasts political science textbook panel; 4 with RSS links among 20 members
content: NCERT has recast the team for preparing political science textbooks for Classes XI and XII, with one of the two books slated to be ready by Nov. The 20-member panel includes faculty from JNU, DU, IGNOU and NLU Delhi, among others. At least four members have links, past or present, with organisations associated with RSS-BJP.

title: 97 case files recalled from UP judge who gave 22 death orders in 4 months
content: Ninety-seven murder case files were recalled from Judge Ravi Kumar Diwakar's court. This action followed his record of awarding death sentences in ten cases. The district and sessions judge ordered the recall of these pending files. Judge Diwakar had previously delivered thirty-five capital punishment verdicts in his career. These recalled files will now be disposed of according to the law.

title: CBI insignia, fake IDs: How Delhi bizman’s wife foiled ‘Special 26’-style raid
content: A fake CBI raid was foiled at a Delhi businessman's residence in Rohini.  The businessman's wife refused entry to individuals claiming to be CBI officers.  These individuals then left after neighbors questioned their authorization.  The family reported the incident and submitted evidence to the police.  Police are now examining CCTV footage and investigating the matter.

title: Kenya helicopter crash kills 7, including 5 Americans, Ecuador intelligence chief
content: the deaths were confirmed by Kenyan authorities and the US state department . the helicopter crashed while travelling from the Loisaba Conservancy towards the Ewaso Nyiro area . seven people, six passengers and the pilot, were on board .

title: Magnitude 5.9 earthquake strikes Flores region in Indonesia
content: the earthquake occurred at a depth of 10 kilometres . the tremor comes days after a powerful 7.7 magnitude earthquake struck off Flores, killing dozens and causing widespread damage in the region . more than 3,000 aftershocks have been recorded sincibly .

title: Pennsylvania crash: State police helicopter, Cessna plane crash after midair collision
content: the cessna 150 collided with a helicopter near a runway in Carlisle, Pennsylvania . both state troopers aboard the helicopter survived the collision . investigators will determine whether the pilot was the only person aboard the plane .

title: Paternity test of child can be allowed in marital dispute: SC
content: a man has sought divorce on the ground of alleged unchaste character of his wife . a bench of justices rejected the plea of a woman who had opposed a paternity test of the child . "if you are loyal, then why should you object to the test," the bench asked .

title: NET row: AI used recklessly to draft questions, say experts
content: experts say generative AI was used extensively to prepare papers . the controversy has forced the national testing agency to order new exams in English, commerce and sociology . a six-week delay in cancelling three flawed tests is at the heart of the UGC-NET controversy .

title: SC to hear NBCC plea for RERA relief in 16 stalled Supertech projects: Case explained
content: NBCC's plea is challenging an order that refused to exempt the company from certain statutory requirements under the Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 (RERA) . the matter will be heard on September 24 along with other pending matters .

title: Mehul Choksi’s lawyer Vijay Aggarwal arrested in UK over sexual assault allegation
content: fugitive diamond businessman mehul Choksi, 57, is in jail charged with four sexual assault offences on two women . his personal assistant, manpreet Kaur, is also in jail for intentionally encouraging the commission of two offences . the pair, both Indian citizens, were arrested on Aug 11 at 29 Brick Street, Mayfair, a serviced luxury ambassadorial town house where they both were staying .

title: South Korea rejects Trump's claim; estimates Kim Jong Un has 80-120 nuclear weapons
content: the remarks were made by defence minister Ahn Gyu-back during a parliamentary session . the minister also said Seoul “cannot acknowledge” the 57-warhead estimate and stressed that South Korea cannot develop nuclear weapons or accept US tactical nuclear weapons .

title: ‘Economic D-Day’: Trump announces ‘most crushing’ operation against Iran and its allies
content: the new measures would target any country whose financial institutions, businesses, airports or government entities provide what he described as a “lifeline” to Iran . he did not specify what penalties Washington would impose or name any country that could be targeted .

title: 'Impose sanctions against RSS': US religious freedom body opposes Bhagwat's visit
content: the united states commission on international religious freedom has urged the government to impose sanctions on members of the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) the commission shared remarks from asif Mahmood, a physician who serves as its chair, and commissioner Gene Mills .

title: 1695 Connecticut home restored for $1m now listed at $1.45m
content: the Ebenezer Grant House, built between 1757 and 1758, has just hit the market for $1.45 million . it was built for merchant Ebenezer grant, a collateral relative of president Ulysses S. Grant . the house once held Ebenezer’s son under Revolutionary War confinement .
